summary: Verified P0 feature 'Görev Paylaşımı + Çok Kişili Atama' end-to-end. Backend pytest test_task_sharing.py = 7/7 pass (serial). Frontend E2E covered: multi-assignee create, share modal (search, add row, 5 perm chips with view locked-on, notify toggle, save), eye badge on shared task, cross-role visibility (mgr_test sees admin's shared task + eye badge), per-user own-completion checkbox (own interactive, others read-only), progress line 'X/Y tamamlandı' updates on toggle, task_shared notification 'serkan bir görevi seninle paylaştı' renders in bell with link to task, single-assignee regression (ownership transfer to ahmet works). One minor bug: eye badge tooltip (title attr) duplicates names (concatenates assignees + shared_with without dedupe).

ui_bugs.issue: title attribute duplicates names — observed 'Bu görevi görenler: mgr_test, emp1_test, emp1_test, mgr_test' when the task has both a multi-assignee list and a shared_with list containing the same people. Needs dedupe by user_id/username before joining.

action_items: Dedupe user names in the task-shared-badge tooltip (title attr). Union assignees ∪ shared_with by user_id/username so a person only appears once.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is very large (~2590 lines). Consider extracting the multi-assignee card block and context menu items into dedicated subcomponents for maintainability.
Eye-badge tooltip currently uses native 'title' attribute which doesn't format as a rich Sertex HUD tooltip. Consider using the same tooltip primitive used elsewhere for consistency.

Single-assignee path stores assignee_name string and transfers ownership via user_id; assignee_user_id on task remains null. Documented but slightly asymmetric with the multi-assignee model (assignees[]). Not a bug, just a note.

rca of the issue: Eye-badge tooltip dedupe bug RCA: badge title is composed by concatenating names from task.assignees[] and task.shared_with[]. When the same user is both an assignee and appears in shared_with (or duplicate share entries), the tooltip repeats them. Fix: use a Set keyed by user_id (fallback username) before Array.join(', '). Reproduction: create multi-assignee task with mgr_test+emp1_test, then share with the same emp1_test → hover badge, see duplicates in title.
